# GUIs — Modern Menu Style Showcase

A curated collection of modern GUI menu templates demonstrating different visual styles and implementation approaches. Every template lives in its own folder and implements the same component set so they can be compared side-by-side.

## Gallery

Click any preview to open that template's folder. Each image is a live screenshot of the demo.

## Component Template

Every menu in this collection includes:

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Header / Title** | Styled with a thematic font and accent color |
| **Primary Button** | Main call-to-action, fully styled |
| **Secondary Button** | Alternate action, visually subordinate |
| **Slider** | Continuous value input (e.g. opacity, volume) |
| **Checkbox** | Boolean toggle with label |
| **Combo / Dropdown** | Select from a list of options |
| **Text Input** | Single-line text field |
| **Status / Output** | Feedback area showing current values |

## How to Run Each Demo

### HTML/CSS/JS demos (no build step)
Open any `index.html` in a modern browser:

```bash
open styles/glassmorphism/index.html
open styles/synthwave/index.html
open internal/game-hud/index.html
```

All files under `styles/` (except `imgui-style/`) and all `internal/` templates are plain HTML.

### Python demos

```bash
# Dear PyGui
pip install dearpygui && python styles/imgui-style/main.py

# tkinter (ttkthemes optional)
python external/tkinter-menu/menu.py

# PyQt6
pip install PyQt6 && python external/pyqt-menu/menu.py

# CustomTkinter
pip install customtkinter && python external/customtkinter/menu.py

# wxPython
pip install wxPython && python external/wxpython/menu.py
```

## Regenerating preview screenshots

Each template folder contains a `preview.png` used in the gallery above.

```bash
pip install playwright pillow
python -m playwright install chromium

python render_html_previews.py    # HTML templates in styles/ and internal/
python render_python_previews.py  # Python demos in external/ and imgui-style/
```

After adding a new template, append its entry to `tools/generate_readme_gallery.py` and refresh the gallery block in this README.

## Adding a New Demo

1. Create a folder under `internal/`, `external/`, or `styles/<theme-name>/`.
2. Implement the full component template (header, two buttons, slider, checkbox, combo, text input, status output).
3. Keep each demo **self-contained** inside its folder — no shared CSS/JS between templates.
4. Run the preview scripts above and add a gallery entry in `tools/generate_readme_gallery.py`.
